change.source: pass 1 F1 lib.rs:494 concurrency CONFIRMED introduced, and pass 2 P5 lib.rs:529 INFEASIBLE: a handle answers from the capture taken at open, so a row appended through another handle is invisible for the handle's life. Coordinator decision, no-op on the evidence of two independent holder enumerations: nothing in the workspace holds an EventlogPlanningStore across two commands — aep serve holds a StoreLocation and opens per request, the writer-control hold process holds no store, DrivenPlan and FileProjectionPublisher open per call, and EventlogMutationLedger holds a PathBuf (pass 2 corrects pass 1 here: it does have a caller, at mutation.rs:367). Pass 2 adds that the one in-process second writer alive beside a handle writes only aep.planning-invocation subjects, which no read path of this store asks about. The rule is written where the field is, in the retained field's doc comment, so a future long-lived holder meets it there rather than in a wave record
